sentences: **Seasons of Interest:** **Bark:** Winter **Bloom:** Spring **Foliage:** Spring, Summer, and Fall **Fruits:** Fall **Quick ID Hints:** - large deciduous tree with dense, upright, oval to rounded crown - dark gray, thin, smooth bark, older bark has the appearance of elephant hide - oval to elliptic, glossy dark green leaves with wavy margins and are ciliate - reddish-brown female flowers are short spikes, greenish-yellow male flowers are drooping, long-stemmed, globular clusters, occurring in the spring - fruits ripen in the fall and are triangular nuts with spiny bracts **Insects, Diseases, and Other Plant Problems:** This tree has no serious insect pests or diseases.
